instruction: Remove the Outlook account "anonym-x2024@outlook.com" from Thunderbird

metadata.explanation: This variation asks to remove the Outlook account 'anonym-x2024@outlook.com'. The evaluator checks that any account with this user email is not present (regardless of server URL). This is a slight variation from the original that focuses on the user email rather than the specific server combination.
